description: This CSS file defines styles for a theme management system, including light and dark themes, for a React application front-end. It contains CSS variables for colors, styles for various components, and responsive design for mobile views.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application container with centered content and background color transitioning based on the theme.

classes.name: App-logo
classes.description: Logo element with animation applied to it.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Header section of the app designed to center align its contents.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Style for links within the application.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Button to toggle between light and dark themes with hover effects.
